variants.text: Face shape: oval; forehead: gently rounded; brow ridge: moderate; glabella width: average; cheekbone width: moderate; jawline: tapering; chin: rounded; eyebrows: medium thickness, soft-arched shape, moderate spacing; eyes: almond-shaped, neutral canthal tilt, average palpebral fissure length, visible double upper-lid creases; nose: straight dorsum, medium width, moderate tip projection, narrow alar base; mouth: average width, medium lip fullness, level corners, defined philtrum; hair: soft-textured, wispy bangs; ears: occluded by hair.

The subject has a soft-textured hairstyle with wispy bangs and an oval face shape characterized by a gently rounded forehead, tapering jawline, and rounded chin. They feature almond-shaped eyes with double upper-lid creases, a straight nose of medium width with a narrow alar base, and medium-full lips. The eyebrows are medium thickness with a soft-arched shape, and the face exhibits a moderate brow ridge and moderate cheekbone width.
